messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Rule today (2024): After completion of five continuous years under the policy no look back to be applied. This period of five years is called the moratorium period.
Replaced rule (2020): After completion of eight continuous years under the policy no look back to be applied. This period of eight years is called as moratorium period.
Existing questions: ['If I increase my sum insured today, when will the new moratorium period start and how long will it be?', 'My policy was bought in 2020; does the five‑year moratorium apply or is it still eight years?']
Write 2 NEW, differently worded questions (e.g. a concrete scenario with a policyholder) whose correct answer today is the 2024 rule. JSON: {"questions": [str, str]}

content: {"questions":["I bought my health insurance in March 2022 and just completed five years of continuous coverage. Does the moratorium now end, or do I still have to wait until eight years?","If I raise my coverage amount next month, from which date does the five‑year moratorium start for the increased sum insured?"]}
